Name: DEPRECATED - Baechu-styled Portraits for Seasonal Outfits for SVE
Author: AkiraE
Description:
[center][/center][center][size=3][color=#ff7700][size=4]I no longer have the time to maintain this mod, and, even if I had, I lack the interest for doing so, as I no longer play the game or have it installed. 
[/size][/color]
[size=4][b][/b][/size][size=4][b]I'm keeping the mod up per request, but keep in mind that it is highly outdated and I no longer offer any support for it.
[/b][/size][color=#ff7700]And by "highly outdated" I mean that you will very likely see the vanilla portraits in a few cases and so on.[/color]

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

﻿﻿Hi!

This is a set of seasonal retextures of SVE portraits in Baechu's style, made for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5975/]Seasonal Outfits for SVE[/url]﻿ by Poltergeister and Tanponponoko, the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5597]non seasonal retextures[/url]﻿ and  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5397]this set of Seasonal Portraits﻿[/url]﻿ I've released in the past.
[/size]
[size=3]═════════════════  *.·:·.☽✧    ✦    ✧☾.·:·.*  ═════════════════
[/size]

[size=4][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b][/size]
[size=3]
 ✦  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5975/]﻿[/url][/size]✦ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5975/]Seasonal Outfits for SVE[/url][size=3]﻿[/size]
[size=3]✦ [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5597]Baechu-styled Portraits for SVE[/url][size=3]﻿ [/size]
[size=1](This last one is optional, but as this mod contains only the characters made to be seasonal, you may want to grab the other ones there).[/size]


[size=3]═════════════════  *.·:·.☽✧    ✦    ✧☾.·:·.*  ═════════════════[/size]


[b][size=4]INSTALLATION[/size]

[size=3]You [u]must[/u] have SVE and Seasonal Outfits for SVE installed beforehand.[/size][/b][size=3]

✦ Unzip the files and drop the folder [b]inside[/b] "[Stardew]Baechu-styled Portraits for SVO for SVE" 
into your main mods folder or into the subfolder you installed the original Seasonal Outfits for SVE (if that's the case) and allow the files to be replaced.
[/size]
(You will need to reinstall my portraits every time you SO for SVE, so keeping a copy of them in a easily reachable place would be wise). [size=3]﻿

[/size][size=3]
═════════════════  *.·:·.☽✧    ✦    ✧☾.·:·.*  ═════════════════


[/size][size=4][b]CREDITS[/b][/size] [size=3]
[/size][size=3]My retextures consists of frankensteined and edited assets from existing portraits by Baechu﻿, therefore, 
these portraits are not my original artwork.

The portraits I used to make my edits are avaible [url=https://cafe.naver.com/starvall/72339]here[/url]﻿.
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]﻿My thanks to Baechu for allowing me edit her portraits and to Poltergeister and Tanponponoko for the original art.[/size][/center]
